explanation: The first sentence holds (a policy with no parentCategory or no supportedOn leaves CategoryID/SupportedCode Nothing and ResolveRef then throws at AdmxBundle.vb 153 and 159). The last sentence, 'The same happens when a child product's parent cannot be found', describes a case the code cannot reach: AdmxFile.vb 74-97 sets a child product's Parent to the product object read just above it in the same file and adds that parent to admx.Products before descending, so the parent id (same namespace, AdmxBundle.vb 139) is always in productIds. Remove that sentence, or restate it as unreachable in one file; do not present it as a way a load stops.
